prompt: Finish the order endpoints in the existing service. Mobile clients create orders and fetch an order later; they automatically retry requests that time out. Login is exposed publicly. Preserve the small dependency-free setup and make the included tests pass.

assertions.description: Invalid order input is rejected without creating data
One account cannot fetch another account's order
A retried order mutation creates one order
Errors are machine-readable and do not leak internals
The public login endpoint has abuse containment
